ingredients: ½ head of iceberg or a head or two romaine lettuce (or some funky bag mixture for 4 people)
2 ripe tomatoes, cut in eighths (or grape/cherry tomatoes cut in half)
1/2 cup Swiss cheese, cut in julienne strips
1/2 cup tasty ham, cut in julienne strips (or turkey or shrimp)
directions: 1/2 cup extra-virgin Spanish (or Italian extra virgin) olive oil
4 cloves garlic, minced (not the 4 big ones or a little too garlicky!)
Mix garlic, oregano, and Worcestershire sauce in a bowl.
Beat until smooth with a wire whisk (says, Columbia, right?! It’s better to do in a mortal and pestle, or best to do the whole thing in a food processor, including mincing the garlic).
Add olive oil, gradually beating to form an emulsion. Stir in vinegar and lemon juice and season with salt and peeper.
Add dressing to salad and toss well.
